Example Teams of a Toy College Football Season

Source: R/data_doc.R
cfb_teams_example.Rd

The team table that pairs with cfb_games_example: nine teams across two conferences plus one independent. Same data as inst/extdata/toy_teams.csv.

Usage

cfb_teams_example

Format

A data frame with the columns cfb_standings() requires:

ColumnTypeDescription
teamcharacterTeam name, matching the game table.
conferencecharacterConference name; "FBS Independents" marks an independent.

See also

cfb_games_example, cfb_standings()

Examples

# \donttest{
cfb_teams_example
#> # A tibble: 9 × 2
#>   team  conference      
#>   <chr> <chr>           
#> 1 A1    Alpha           
#> 2 A2    Alpha           
#> 3 A3    Alpha           
#> 4 A4    Alpha           
#> 5 B1    Beta            
#> 6 B2    Beta            
#> 7 B3    Beta            
#> 8 B4    Beta            
#> 9 I1    FBS Independents
# }
